_about: The print catalog loaded into Xpot (docs/PRINT_EXECUTION_PLAN.md s10). Serialized v1 recipes are the bed recipes of each model's latest batch in the 3D Printing repo; part beds name the fixed files of PRINT NOW.

models.title: Stand Large · Google Review · White
models.description: Production plate, batch REV-2026-003, serials 001-002-003-004: one Google card per Smart Tags code, PLA. Written by production.py plate; settings from build-google-large-test-pla.json.

recipe._pause: The cavity roof is at print z 2.92; with 0.16 layers and no top band, pause at the start of the 2.92-3.08 roof layer.
recipe._first_layer_sequence: Art first on the face (layer 1): black, then the colour, then the body (white) last, which seals it (user, 2026-10-11: white first on 2026-10-10 came out worse). Dark tile: the same rule mirrored, the art (white + colours) first and the black body last. Rule: the body filament is always last on the face.

pause.text: Insert one programmed round NFC tag (NTAG215, 25 mm, 0.8 mm or thinner) into each cavity, by the serial map; resume.

models.title: Stand Small · Google Review · White (legacy)
models.description: The first Small Stand cards (2026-10-04), QR on skale.club/q/ (redirects to Xpot). Kept for its batch; retired.

recipe._pause: first roof layer over the NFC cavity: the cavity ends at print z 2.92, the next 0.16 layer is 2.92-3.08 (no top band, so no 0.08 layers). gcode-verify 2026-10-03: pause at 3.08, first Bridge on that layer after it The pause is written on every plate; plate 2 (tokens, 1.0 mm tall) never reaches it.
recipe._top_band: none, on purpose (2026-10-03): face-down, so the top is the card's BACK, not the face. The slow 0.08 band there cost 24 min per card (78.1 -> 54.0 min single, A/B sliced). The face is the first layer and is untouched.

settings._grid: the keychains' grid: first layer 0.20, then 0.16 (inlay 0.52, cavity 1.64-2.92)
settings._geometry: keychain-baseline walls and shells, copied inline because that preset also carries PETG-only top flow
settings._first_layer: the face is the first layer: keep the template's 0.36 line for the QR's 0.8 mm modules
settings._enable_support: the G recess opens onto the plate; its ceiling is a ~3 mm bridge (projection slice, 2026-10-02)
settings._first_layer_fix: the PLA face tests (2026-10-03): elephant-foot compensation 0 (it thinned every letter 0.075 per side), layer 1 slow

recipe._size: SMALL version (user, 2026-10-03: "too small, keep it saved in case it is needed"): card 60 x 85 x 3.56, base 68 x 48 x 12, lean 20 deg. Fusion Tools/NFC Counter Plaque version 8; archive/NFC Plaque Small - Fusion v8.f3d; meshes source/mesh/small/.

pause.text: Insert one programmed round NFC tag (NTAG215, 25 mm, 0.8 mm or thinner) into each cavity, by the serial map; resume.

models.title: Plate Large · Instagram · White
models.description: Instagram NFC Plate, Large 103 x 103 x 3.56, white, four on one A1 plate (2 x 2 around the prime tower: NFC/Plate/NOTES.md, 'Sizes for the A1'). Meshes from source/design/tile_per_code.py, one folder per code (<serial>/White_Instagram_Plate.stl, Black_Instagram_Art.stl, Silk_Instagram_Logo.stl). Settings, filaments and the NFC pause are the Instagram Stand cards' (build-instagram-large-sample-pla.json, finish v4): white tile, black art, Eryone Silk PLA Dual-Color pink to purple icon; prints face-down; the tag goes in at the pause, z 2.76.

recipe._pause: The cavity roof is at print z 2.92; with 0.16 layers and no top band, pause at the start of the 2.92-3.08 roof layer.
recipe._tower: Tower 30 mm at x 113-143 in a 42 mm channel (tiles at +-72.5, 4 mm from the plate edges): with the packing-study spacing (+-70.5, 4 mm each side of the tower) Bambu Studio refused the slice, 'G-code conflicts ... move the wipe tower further from other models' (2026-10-10).
recipe._first_layer_sequence: White first on the face (first layer), then the others (user, 2026-10-10: "o branco antes")

pause.text: Insert one programmed round NFC tag (NTAG215, 25 mm, 0.8 mm or thinner) into each cavity, by the serial map; resume.
